items.problem: Disabled PhotoButton/VideoButton glyphs render faintly in WinUI 3 vs visibly in UWP (minor cosmetic delta).
items.evidence: discrepancies.json D1: UIA confirms both buttons present at correct positions with isEnabled=false; difference is only the default WinUI disabled-visual styling over a white background.
items.covered_clearly_at: Out of scope for a skill rule — this is the framework's default disabled control styling, not a migration mistake, and the controls are functionally correct (disabled because no camera).
items.why_no_skill_change: Cosmetic-only, no functional or behavioral regression (score stayed 100). Encoding a per-control disabled-visual tweak would be scenario-specific over-fitting; a re-run would produce the same correct, fully-functional result.
